title: A request: header, work rows and validation before saving
goal: Save a consistent request and model repeating work rows without replacing existing fields.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 4; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: A header says 30 minutes and rows say 20+10. Equal numbers do not establish an automatic calculation. Check what is stored at each level. Then change one row and see why a manual comparison must be described as manual.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: The previous ReportsV 2 fixture stores request headers but has neither Работы nor a custom explicit form. In a prepared separate copy add the table and form only through the lesson steps below. Preserve the A 4 customer note and old documents. The example and new work use different own sets; do not substitute a whole-database total for two particular numbers. Nexus stores the explanation and note; perform the actions in installed1C.

sections.title: A document records a specific event
paragraphs: A request has its own reference, date and number. The same customer and service may recur, so their pair is not necessarily a document key. Use the reference or an agreed external identity for reopening. Do not create another document when correcting the same request.

The starter request has one service and ДлительностьМинут in its header. This represents one request adequately. The single Услуга field is not a tabular section. Работы is not already present in the unchanged starter: this lesson creates it as a separate teaching extension in a new copy, retaining earlier attributes and documents.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: The row total is not assigned automatically; this lesson reconciles manually.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

Manual control: 20 + 10 = 30

sections.title: How to carry out the worked example
paragraphs: Follow the route in your prepared own copy. This is the worked example; the new task below uses different data. Compare each expectation with your actual reread.

Step 1. Close Enterprise, save a DT and restore it only into a new empty infobase with a new name/directory, following module 1. Record an earlier document’s fields. Expected: Source retained; new copy opens independently.

Step 2. Under Tabular sections add Работы. Inside it add Услуга: CatalogRef.Услуги and Минуты: Number, length 5, precision 0. Keep existing header attributes. Expected: Работы is a tabular section, not a header attribute.
Step 3. Review the change list: only Работы and its fields are added, with no old objects removed. Update this copy, then launch Enterprise. Expected: The copy updates and older requests open.

Step 4. Fill customer, service, Новая and 30 header minutes. Add two Работы rows with existing services and 20/10 minutes. Save and close; record the number. Expected: A new document retains two rows.

Step 5. Reopen and check 30/20+10. In a new draft, fill rows but leave the customer empty and attempt saving. After rejection close only that draft without saving. Expected: Saved work intact; incomplete header rejected.

sections.title: Writing differs from posting
paragraphs: Writing persists document fields. Posting performs configured accounting actions that may be absent from the initial stand. An icon or command name does not prove register movements. A5 requires correct writing and field verification; P5–P6 separately cover posting, rejection and movements. Do not attribute future functionality to the starter template.

A tabular section stores repeating rows inside one document. Create Работы with Услуга: CatalogRef.Услуги and Минуты: Number(5,0). Do not rename the header ДлительностьМинут. Rows of 20 and 10 give a manual control of 30, but their existence does not automatically assign that total to the header; automatic calculation requires an explicit rule.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: A new table row changes from 35 to 40 while the header was 50. Without a developed calculation will the header automatically become 55?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Header and tabular section hold separate data. Reread the actual value: in this fixture it remains 50. The row sum 40+15=55 requires an explicit adjustment; adding a table does not create a calculation rule.

sections.title: Status transitions need rules
paragraphs: An enumeration defines values, not permission for every transition. New → InProgress → Closed is an agreed path; reopening a closed request needs another rule. Specify allowed transitions and identify where they are enforced. Filtering by status neither changes status nor replaces transition validation.

The existing handler validates required header fields and duration bounds. The new table is not automatically connected to the customer report, posting or per-row validation. Enter 30 in the header and 20/10 in rows, explicitly noting manual reconciliation. Filled rows do not remove the header requirements: missing header input must still be rejected.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Use the second worked case only in an own copy or unsaved draft. Preserve the accepted record and explain the discrepancy.
Add Работы in a separate copy first; the starter has one header service.

sections.title: Rereading separates buffer from database
paragraphs: An open form can show unsaved values. Save, close and reopen the same identity. Verify fields, list total and document count. For a rejected write, compare before/after state. This catches a screen showing corrected 30 minutes while the database still contains 45.

Before updating, create a separate copy through module 1 and compare older documents after adding the table. They should retain the same headers and have empty new rows. An empty new table is expected, not loss of the original service. Do not automatically migrate or populate old documents without a separate task.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Only in your new verified copy containing Работы create a separate request: header 50 and rows 35 and 15 with existing services. Save, close and reread. Change the first row to 40, save and check the header still says 50 while the manual sum is 55. Explicitly correct the header to 55 and reread both levels. In another unsaved draft fill rows but leave Customer empty: saving must be refused without changing saved requests.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: Two newly restored copies in actual1C verify references after renaming, row persistence, absence of automatic recalculation, empty-header refusal, the actual named form and fresh reads. Main 9/255 and independent 9/290 include earlier 4/120. All old fields and the A 4 note persist. Two GUI captures show only their labelled forms. Manual wizard, full Tab, permissions, installer, devices and learner understanding are NOT RUN.

sections.title: What the result establishes
paragraphs: Two newly restored copies in actual1C verify references after renaming, row persistence, absence of automatic recalculation, empty-header refusal, the actual named form and fresh reads. Main 9/255 and independent 9/290 include earlier 4/120. All old fields and the A 4 note persist. Two GUI captures show only their labelled forms. Manual wizard, full Tab, permissions, installer, devices and learner understanding are NOT RUN.
Technical checks do not assess understanding. Distinguish your observations from unperformed steps. Training names, numbers and comments are fictional; no work data is required.

selfcheck.prompt: After a row changes 35→40, how do you align header 50?
selfcheck.feedback: After the first save I read header 50 and rows 35/15. After changing a row I read header 50 and 40/15: observed absence of automatic assignment. Explicitly saving 55 aligns the header with the manual sum; reopening retains 55/40/15. Another draft with an empty customer is refused; the saved-document count and fields stay unchanged. Работы is not claimed to feed the report, posting or per-row validation; the existing report uses its header rule.
